items.title: Instrument recording the 1667 acquisition of Tŷ Mawr by the Williams family

items.why: The 1667 acquisition is reported in the 1974 newspaper reports (Mary Williams' statement) and by ITV News in 1988. A transfer of land in 1667 would have been made by a written instrument; no copy is in the archive.

items.title: Mountjoy mortgage over Western Ground Rents property and its discharge (register of charges)

items.why: The Labour Research Department (1944) lists Mountjoy among WGR's mortgage lenders. Company charges had to be registered (Companies Act 1929, s.79), and a sale free of the charge needs a recorded release.
